items.title: Does Earnings Growth Change The Bull Case For Con Edison (ED)?
items.summary: Consolidated Edison reported third quarter 2026 revenue of US$4,913 million and net income of US$766 million, with higher basic and diluted earnings per share from continuing operations compared with the same period in 2025. The utility is pairing this earnings performance with plans for major New York grid upgrades, including distribution-level storage and up to 1 GW of land-based renewables annually, alongside participation in the Propel NY Energy transmission build out.
